tasks.subject: Task 0: Commit the pending package-rename work
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Start from a clean tree so each subsequent task commits only its own changes.

**Verify:** git status --short | wc -l → 0; just test → 13 passed

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "git status --short | wc -l && just test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["clean tree", "13 tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Unified release recipe in the justfile
tasks.description:
**Goal:** just release (no arg) computes CalVer, stamps six version sites, tests, commits, signs tag, pushes; validate_version checks all six; demo-release deleted.

**Verify:** just _stamp-version stamps exactly 6 files; validate_version passes/fails correctly; revert after dry-run.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["justfile"], "verifyCommand": "just --summary | grep release && grep -c demo-release justfile", "acceptanceCriteria": ["6-file stamp", "validate_version six sites", "demo-release deleted"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: One release workflow
tasks.description:
**Goal:** release.yml builds all three packages, two-artifact split, one GitHub Release, pages dispatch; demo-release.yml deleted; pages.yml comment updated.

**Verify:** yaml parses; demo-release.yml gone; zizmor no new findings.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/release.yml", ".github/workflows/pages.yml", ".github/workflows/demo-release.yml"], "verifyCommand": "uv run python -c \"import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/release.yml'))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["two artifacts", "pypi jobs untouched", "pages dispatch", "demo-release.yml deleted"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Delete old per-package releases and tags
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove demo-lib-v2026.8.4 and demo-app-v2026.8.4 releases and tags, remote and local. No commit.

**Verify:** gh release list empty; no demo-* tags local or remote.

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "gh release list | wc -l && git tag -l 'demo-*' | wc -l", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no releases", "no demo tags anywhere"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Documentation sweep + full gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** AGENTS.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md describe the unified CalVer flow; just check-all passes.

**Verify:** grep for demo-release/semantic versioning in docs → 0 hits; just check-all → exit 0.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AGENTS.md", "README.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md"], "verifyCommand": "just check-all", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no stale flow docs", "check-all green"]}
```
